title: Consumption thresholds
subtitle: These limits apply only to this project and are used to generate personalized alerts and recommendations.

defaults.label: Use the system's default thresholds
defaults.hint: Default thresholds are set for an average household consumption. Turn them off to define your own limits for this project.

readOnly.notice: Only the project owner can change these thresholds.

scopeNote: Each project keeps its own thresholds; changing these won't affect your other projects.

errors.monthlyLessThanDaily: The monthly limit must be greater than or equal to the daily one
